Market today: The mood is cautious to negative for tech and chips. The real driver is the unexpected news of Jensen Huang's resignation from Nvidia, creating significant uncertainty for the AI and semiconductor sectors, which directly impacts your concentrated book.

Your holdings: Several leveraged ETFs are deep in the red, amplifying losses on margin. SOXL is down a staggering -72.29%, MUU -54.04%, and SPAL -43.9%. SMH is also down -22.02% and below its stop. QQQI, your income anchor, is a "SELL" at -8.2% and very close to its stop.

Watch: Closely monitor Nvidia's stock performance and the broader chip sector's reaction to the CEO news. Pay immediate attention to your stops, especially on the heavily losing leveraged ETFs.

Bottom line: This is a critical time for risk management; prioritize protecting capital over chasing new gains.
plays: SOXL: This leveraged ETF is down -72.29% and far below its stop. Consider exiting this position to stem further decay and capital loss.
SMH: With a -22.02% loss and currently below its stop of 540, respect your stop and trim or exit this chip ETF.
QQQI: Your income anchor is a "SELL" at -8.2% and trading just below its 52 stop. Consider trimming or exiting if it doesn't recover quickly.
